info.name: iCloud Albums Sync
info.summary: Sync iCloud Shared Albums to Nextcloud
info.description:
Automatically sync iCloud Shared Albums to your Nextcloud instance.
Features: - Discover and sync iCloud shared albums - Automatic sync at configurable intervals - Approve/reject album shares - Home Assistant notifications for new shares - File deduplication using SHA256 hashing - Bi-directional sync (iCloud → Nextcloud)
This app requires a separate sync service to be running. See the documentation for setup instructions.
info.author: iCloud Albums Sync Contributors
